text:
sara_prod: quick sync — we need a concise plan for new per-model/route SLO dashboards (latency p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Can runtime/infra + console agree what signals we need and who owns emission/ingest/dashboard work?

mike_runtime: +1. from runtime side: we currently emit request_latency_ms histogram (no route tag) and token_count counter. Need to add route/model labels. Also thinking about a separate ttft measure because batching masks single-request latency.

julia_obs: TTFT is tricky with batching. propose: measure path-level TTFT as "time_from_first_client_byte_to_last_token_emitted" per request_id; emit as summary/timer and derive p50/p95/p99. Also emit tokens_per_request and tokens/sec as a derived gauge via rate(tokens_total[1m]) grouped by model, route.

eden_console: Console needs per-route series with p50/p95/p99 and a tokens/sec panel. Want consistent label: model, route, region, capacity_tier, rollout_tag. Also add a small table view for recent regressions (eval set failures).

nate_infra: ingestion concern: high-cardinality labels (rollout_tag + route + model) x tokens/sec at 1s resolution = cost. We should decide sampling or pre-aggregation at runtime. Suggest runtime emits aggregated tokens_per_minute per (model,route,region,capacity_tier) and continues raw counters at lower frequency.

mike_runtime: ok on aggregation. Plan: emit these metrics (names below). We'll add a switch to toggle detailed emission for dedicated customers.

```
# proposed metric names
model_route_request_latency_ms: histogram buckets: [1,2,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000,2500]
model_route_ttft_ms: summary
model_route_tokens_total: counter
model_route_tokens_per_minute: gauge (runtime-aggregated)
```

kevin_platform: console + routing UX: also need to show fallback routing behavior in the dashboard (how often requests hit fallback model). Can we add "route_outcome" label (ok, fallback, overloaded, rejected)?

julia_obs: yes add route_outcome. For alerting we want: p99_latency > X ms for 5m AND traffic>Y. We should standardize thresholds per model class.

sara_prod: owners draft: runtime (mike) -> metric emission + tests; infra (nate) -> ingestion config + cost estimate; observability (julia) -> sample queries + alert thresholds; console (eden) -> panel mockups + API for rollouts tag. kevin -> UX for showing fallback counts. Target: initial implementation for dev tier in 2 weeks, pilot for dedicated in 6 weeks.

mike_runtime: I'll add PR to runtime repo with metric additions and feature flag: `emit_model_route_metrics`. Will include sample PromQL in PR. ETA 1w.

nate_infra: I'll produce ingestion cost estimate and suggested sampling/aggregation config. Also will add a "route_telemetry" kafka topic for high-throughput pre-aggregated messages. ETA 4d.

julia_obs: I'll author canonical queries: p50/p95/p99 from histogram and TTFT summary example + alert rules. Example PromQL for p95 latency: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(model_route_request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))`. TTFT p95: `quantile_over_time(0.95, model_route_ttft_ms[5m])` (or use summary). Will post full query set. ETA 3d.

eden_console: I'll sketch panel layouts (time-series + heatmap + table) and wire up a mock route filter for rollout_tag and route_outcome. Will need a tiny API change to accept `group_by` for tokens/sec. ETA 5d.

kevin_platform: we'll need rollout UX for canary: show metrics side-by-side between rollout_tag values and a small comparison sparkline. I'll mock in figma and share link.

sara_prod: action items summarized: 1) mike add metrics + feature flag (owner: mike_runtime) 2) nate configure ingestion + topic + cost (nate_infra) 3) julia produce queries + alerts (julia_obs) 4) eden mock panels + console API (eden_console) 5) kevin mock rollout UX (kevin_platform) 6) sara will schedule follow-up sync Thu 10am PT. Please add tasks to the eng-platform board.

deploy-bot: Note: deploy window for runtime change is daily canary at 03:30 UTC. Please schedule PR accordingly.

sara_prod: thanks all — if anyone has constraints on ETA ping here. Otherwise I'll book the follow-up and link the tickets when ready. :thumbsup:
